# OKCompressor / OKC

OKC builds reversible information systems: structural codecs,
model-facing transforms, experimental coders and reproducible research artifacts.

## Current architecture

- DU3 — active reversible structural baseline.
- Rare1 — optional long-tail transform under active Rust validation.
- zRank — experimental reversible model transform.
- Entropy — pluggable; current published measurements use zstd as a reference backend.

## Important pages

- / — current OKC / DUMBer V1G surface
- /projects/tools.html — module and tools shelf
- /projects/rare1.html — Rare1 research module
- /products/zrank.html — zRank research module
- /research/working-note-001.html — representation working note
- /research/doe-001.html — reproducibility working note
- /licensing.html — licensing boundary
- /contact.html — builds, integration and research

## Benchmark discipline

OKC reports separate dimensions:
FASTEST, SMALLEST, NETWORK and STRUCTURE.

Intermediate representations are not described as complete archives.
Exactness boundaries and dataset provenance are stated explicitly.

## Licensing

Canonical licence:
https://github.com/OKCompressor/core/blob/main/docs/LICENSE.md

Current licensing line: LNCL 1.2.
Artifact-specific terms and release files control.

## Boundaries

Experimental software.
No hidden dependency between DU3, Rare1, zRank or entropy backends.
Ganymede remains historical R&D evidence, not the production architecture.
